title: Special Positions in a Binary Matrix
description: A cell containing 1 is special when it is the only 1 in its row and the only 1 in its column. Given a binary matrix `mat`, count the special cells. Input: rectangular binary matrix `mat`. Output: the number of special positions.
hints: Check each cell using its row and column relationships.
Handle single-row, single-column, tie, and center-cell cases explicitly.
